backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing study session tracking with Pomodoro timer management, session recording with distraction metrics, and data storage for user sessions and goals using core data structures (Set, Map, List).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (logo design, header placement, dashboard styling, light/dark mode theming) to source files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing component layouts, styling improvements, hooks for timer/detection logic, and the minimal card-based design system with rounded corners and soft shadows.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color schemes including background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the FocusGuard React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, timer, and dashboard pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider with Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/CameraMonitor.ts: Floating camera monitor component displaying live video feed with status badges for face presence, phone detection, and seated status, featuring minimize/maximize toggle and rounded card design.
frontend/src/components/CyclePrompt.tsx: Modal dialog prompting users after break completion to either start the next Pomodoro cycle or end the study session with two action buttons.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard component displaying study statistics, metrics cards (total time, focused time, focus score, streak), weekly/daily graphs, insights, and goal-setting integration using recharts for visualization.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Alert dialog component that displays context-specific warnings for different distraction types (phone, sleeping, face-not-detected, not-seated) with corresponding titles and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/FeatureCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying features with an icon (or icon image), title, description, and optional animation delay for staggered entrance effects.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright information and attribution link to caffeine.ai with animated heart icon and dynamic UTM parameters.
frontend/src/components/GoalSetting.tsx: Component for setting and editing daily study goals in hours and minutes, with inline editing mode and integration with useStudyGoals hook.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header navigation with logo, navigation buttons (Home, Timer, Dashboard), and theme toggle, using TanStack Router for navigation.
frontend/src/components/MotivationalQuot: Card component that displays rotating motivational quotes, cycling through a predefined list every 5 minutes with a quote icon.
frontend/src/components/MusicControlButt: Button component for toggling focus music playback with visual state indication (animated pulse when playing) and music icon.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Full-featured music player dialog with category selection, volume control, loop mode, custom playlist management, file import, and track listing functionality using useAudioPlayer hook.
frontend/src/components/SiteBlockWarning: Alert dialog that notifies users when they attempt to access blocked websites during study sessions, displaying the site name and remaining session time.
frontend/src/components/StudyGraph.tsx: Bar chart component using recharts to visualize daily study hours data with customized styling for dark/light theme support.
frontend/src/components/StudyTimer.tsx: React component that implements a focus timer with Pomodoro and custom modes, auto-pause on distractions (phone, head down, face detection loss), and cycle management with motivational quotes and prompts.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: React component that provides a button to toggle between light and dark themes using next-themes, with sun/moon icons and smooth transitions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the Internet Computer backend actor instance, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on identity state and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudioPlayer.ts: Custom React hook that manages audio playback with multiple music categories (lofi, instrumental, white noise, nature sounds, classical), custom playlists stored in IndexedDB, volume control, loop mode, and auto-play functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useDistractionDetecti: Custom React hook that detects when users are distracted by monitoring browser visibility changes and window focus/blur events, tracking distraction start times.
frontend/src/hooks/useFaceDetection.ts: Custom React hook that performs real-time face detection using canvas-based image analysis, detecting face presence, head-down position, and tracking face detection loss duration with smoothing algorithms.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and context provider for Internet Identity authentication on Internet Computer, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useObjectDetection.ts: Custom React hook that uses canvas-based edge detection to identify rectangular objects (phones) in video frames, with adaptive frame rate and position tracking to reduce false positives.
frontend/src/hooks/usePoseDetection.ts: Custom React hook that analyzes vertical brightness distribution in video frames to detect seated vs. standing posture, using adaptive baseline calibration for personalized detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all study sessions and recording new sessions to the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteBlocker.ts: Custom hook that simulates detection of blocked social media sites during active study sessions (note: actual blocking requires browser extension).
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyGoals.ts: Custom hook for managing daily study goals stored in localStorage, with progress tracking and goal achievement status.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyStats.ts: Custom hook that calculates comprehensive study statistics including daily/weekly hours, focus score, streaks, distraction metrics, and performance insights from session data.
frontend/src/hooks/useTimer.ts: Custom hook managing Pomodoro or custom study timers with automatic pause/resume on distraction detection, session recording to backend, and tracking of focused time, breaks, and distractions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for light/dark themes, including refined color palettes for reduced eye strain, custom animations, and utility classes for cards and transitions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Simple page component that renders the Dashboard component within a styled container with gradient background.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page component with hero section, feature cards showcasing camera monitoring/music/blocking/analytics, and call-to-action buttons to start focus sessions or view dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/TimerPage.tsx: Main timer page that orchestrates study sessions with camera monitoring, face/object/pose detection hooks, distraction warnings, site blocking alerts, and music player controls.
frontend/src/utils/audioStorage.ts: IndexedDB utility for storing, retrieving, and managing audio files locally by playlist, including save/get/delete/list operations with metadata tracking.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions for colors (OKLCH format), spacing, border radius, typography, shadows, and animations using shadcn/ui design tokens.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining FocusGuard as a study productivity app with architecture notes (React/TensorFlow.js/MediaPipe), known browser/detection limitations, and existing features for timer, camera monitoring, and distraction detection.
